newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on exporter, fund demand.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on exporter, fund demand.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on fund and exporter demand, traders said.

"Chicago was up and tripped buy stops and we had late fund short covering with exporter and crusher buying of the deferreds," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin fell to -25.32 from -24.74 Tuesday on CBOT soy oil and meal forcing one Alberta crusher to announce layoffs within two weeks. March-May spread $1.20, March-July $1.80. Volume was 8,056 lots, or 161,120 tonnes, with 348 hedges.
March canola rose $4.20 to $410.70 and May closed up $4.50 at $409.50. March flax rose $5.20 to $348.50. Volume was 136.

February western barley lost $1 to $136 on more farmer hedges and Alberta Wheat Pool long liquidation met by commission short covering, March down $0.70 to $135.10. Feb Mar spread at $0.50, Feb-May $1, Mar-May $0.30.
March feed wheat rose $0.20 to $169.50, May lost $0.50 to $165.50 on commercial selling and light hedges.
Commercials traded May oats up US$1.50 to US$198.50. Feed peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats and peas.)
